title: Thank You for the Rubbish
overview: Self-proclaimed “information spy” Benjamin Pell, the subject of Iain Jones’ raucous docu “Thank You for the Rubbish,” travels by night, stealthily spiriting away waste from London’s top entertainment law firms, MI-5 agents and Prime Minister Tony Blair, selling the gossipy scoops therein to an eager client list of the U.K.’s top newspapers and tabloids.
